headline: Bitcoin is holding around $80,000 on Sunday as the US pulls staff from more Middle East embassies after Iranian threats, with no strike and no deal so far.

market.fearGreed: 45 (Neutral) on CoinMarketCap's Fear & Greed Index, read about 07:59 UTC

stories.title: Bitcoin holds around $80,000 as the US pulls diplomats from more Middle East posts
stories.summary: There has been no US strike on Iran and no deal. The news overnight shifted to US staff safety: Iranian officials were reported to be preparing to target US diplomats, and the State Department is cutting staff at more embassies in the region. Bitcoin has stayed close to $80,000 after dipping below it on Saturday.
points: Trump on a new strike: "We're thinking about doing it, and maybe tomorrow," while saying a deal was also possible, per Middle East Eye.

Two Iranian officials told the New York Times that Tehran is preparing to target US diplomats; the State Department is cutting staff in Jordan, Lebanon, Qatar and the UAE, per the Times of Israel live blog.
Non-essential US staff are also being pulled from Riyadh, Jeddah and Dhahran in Saudi Arabia, per The Week.
Saturday's low is reported slightly differently: $79,146 (Investing.com) and $79,220 (BeInCrypto). BeInCrypto put bitcoin at $80,546 at 06:38 UTC Sunday.
Brent crude is above $117 a barrel, per Investing.com, which keeps inflation worries alive before the Fed meets this week.

stories.title: Weekend DeFi hacks: X100 attack still running, Initia still offline
stories.summary: Attackers used borrowed money to win a voting majority in the X100 protocol's on-chain "Senate" and drained its treasury; security firm Blockaid says the attack is still going on. The Initia blockchain remains paused after an attacker created unbacked tokens and moved money out, with no restart date.
points: X100 losses are reported as about $4.85M in USDT (CryptoTimes, citing Blockaid) and about $4.75M (BlockSec, via KuCoin).
The X token fell 96.52% to $1.78, per CryptoTimes.
Initia: 1.4M AUSD, 105 ETH and 1.08M USDC were bridged out within 7 minutes 21 seconds, per Unchained; the roughly $2.7M total is an estimate.
Initia has given no restart date, per Unchained and TokenPost.

stories.title: Big week ahead: Fed decision Wednesday, monthly bitcoin options expiry Friday
stories.summary: The Fed announces its rate decision on Wednesday and a large batch of monthly bitcoin options expires on Friday. Both can move prices. US spot bitcoin ETFs, funds that hold bitcoin for stock-market investors, have swung between big inflows and outflows.
points: Fed: the range is 3.75-4.00%, and 94 of 100 economists in a Reuters poll expect a hold on Wed 28 Oct, per Newsquawk.
US spot bitcoin ETFs lost $635.49M on 22 Oct, a day after drawing $528.40M, per BeInCrypto.
Monthly bitcoin options on Deribit expire Fri 30 Oct at 08:00 UTC (15:00 Bangkok); a 17 Oct estimate put the size at about $12.2B, per CryptoTicker.

briefs.title: Keystone wallet store breach exposes buyers' addresses
briefs.summary: Customer names, contact details, shipping addresses and purchase details were exposed; Keystone has not said exactly how. It says seed phrases, private keys and payment data are safe, and warns of fake refund and replacement-device scams, per Bitcoin.com News.

briefs.title: Strategy buys 267 BTC while spending $193M on share buybacks
briefs.summary: Strategy spent $193M buying back its own preferred shares but added only 267 BTC, per Investing.com.
